title: Check yourself: Retries, conflicts, chunks, honest accuracy and the practice

questions.stem: An extraction fails a check because the printed total differs from the sum of the lines, and the record has `conflict_detected` set to true. What should the pipeline do?

options.text: Retry with the error message appended to the prompt
options.says: Ruled out because "a second look will find the same difference", so the retry cannot change the outcome.

options.text: Replace the printed total with the computed one
options.says: Ruled out because "A record that carries a difference and says so is a correct record of a bad document", and replacing the printed value hides what it says.

options.text: Route it to a person with the discrepancy noted
options.says: A flagged conflict is information about a bad source, and a second look finds the same difference.

options.text: Mark the document failed once the retry limit is reached
options.says: Ruled out because this record is not invalid, since "a document that is still invalid after the last one is marked failed" applies to errors that are retried.

questions.stem: A pipeline reports 98 percent accuracy over the documents that passed its checks, while 30 percent of all documents did not pass. What is wrong with the figure?

options.text: It excludes every failure from its base
options.says: The denominator is filtered by the pipeline's own verdict, which drops the documents most likely to be wrong.

options.text: It understates accuracy for the passing set
options.says: Ruled out because the filtered figure is the higher one: "accuracy over the validated is 5 of 6, 0.83, and accuracy over all documents is 5 of 10, 0.5".

options.text: It counts each one twice, once per rule
options.says: Ruled out because it "leaves out the documents that went to review or failed", and nothing is counted twice.

options.text: It counts reviewed documents as passed
options.says: Ruled out because the report "divides by the documents that passed, which are the easy ones".

origin.section: The accuracy that hides the failures
